information.impactAccountNameSubText: The Impact Account name is the name used to represent this account. It can be a meaningful name that’s shared when gifts are sent and can be displayed on your personal profile if you choose.

infoToShare.contactInformationSubHeader: Contact information that can be shared when sending gifts.

infoToShare.infoToShareSubHeader: Select the default information you’d like to share when sending gifts. You can choose from sharing your Impact Account Name or your Impact Account name and the contact information provided above. Or, you can give anonymously. If you share your Impact Account name, others can view your Impact Account profile if it’s discoverable.

privacy.displayName: Display name and link to personal profile

privacy.closeAccountMessage: When you close this Impact Account, you will no longer have access to the Impact Account profile or the giving activity for this account. Once this Impact Account is closed, it cannot be reopened.
privacy.closeAccountMessageBottom: If you have admins on this Impact Account, they will no longer be able to manage this account once it's closed.
privacy.closeAccountHeaderMessage: We are required to keep records of your donations and tax receipts for up to 7 years. This is a requirement from the Canada Revenue Agency in compliance with the Income Tax Act.
privacy.closeAccountDefaultHeaderText: Action is required before closing this Impact Account
privacy.closeAccountDefaultTitleText: This Impact Account is set as default
privacy.closeAccountDefaultText: To close this account, select another Impact Account as the default.
privacy.closeAccountDefaultTextThree: to change your default account setting.
privacy.transferYourAdminRoleDescription: You are the only admin for a Giving Group or Campaign. Transfer your admin role to someone else before closing your account.

profile.givingGoalNotSetText: A giving goal hasn't been set.
profile.addGoalInfo1: Set a personal goal for the dollars you want to commit for giving. Reach your goal by adding money to your account throughout the calendar year.
profile.addGoalInfo2: Goals are reset to $0 at the start of each year, and you can update your goal anytime.
profile.causesModalSubHeader: Select causes and topics to see charities and Giving Groups that might interest you.
profile.causesAndTopicsModalsubHeader: Select causes and topics to see suggestions that match the interests of this account. These suggestions will appear when you search for somewhere to give.
profile.causesAndTopicsModalsubHeader2: Causes and topics you select are shown on the Impact Account profile. You can adjust the privacy settings to control who can see this information. We do not share selected causes and topics with charities.
profile.causesSectionInfoText: Causes represent broader areas of charitable interests.
profile.topicsSectionInfoText: Topics represent specific areas of charitable interests.
profile.findCharityInfo: Charities added as favourites will appear here. Create a list of favourites by selecting the heart on charity pages.

overview.takeActionText: Take action by giving the money in your account away to charities, Giving Groups, or friends for them to give away.

admins.infoModalSecondText: Admins can add money, send gifts, and schedule deposits and gifts—just like the account owner. Share access to your account with people you trust like your partner or spouse, or financial advisor. You can have a total of {{maxLimit}} admins. This includes pending admin invitations. If you need to add more admins, contact our team for help.
